title: Howland
tagline: Private AI on your own computer, with no internet
context: Howland is private AI with a coding agent that runs on your own computer with no internet, beside an offline reference library.
delivered: Chat, a coding agent, the world map and your own web search, on hardware you own
An offline reference library beside the AI
Runs on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android, with a Go installer
Built with hand-written code and AI coding agents working in parallel
